table account
  col accessToken                    text
  col accessTokenExpiresAt           timestamp with time zone
  col accountId                      text NOT NULL
  col createdAt                      timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

  col idToken                        text
  col issuer                         text
  col password                       text
  col providerId                     text NOT NULL
  col refreshToken                   text
  col refreshTokenExpiresAt          timestamp with time zone
  col scope                          text
  col updatedAt                      timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col userId                         text NOT NULL
  pk  account_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  fk  account_userId_fkey FOREIGN KEY ("userId") REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  rls enabled

  col last_used_at                   timestamp with time zone
  col member_issued                  boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
  col name                           text NOT NULL
  col organization                   text
  col permissions_mode               text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scoped'::text
  col rate_limit                     integer
  col request_count                  bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  col rls_bypass                     boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
  col scopes                         jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb
  col tenant_id                      uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT (NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid
  fk  zv_api_keys_created_by_fkey FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  uq  zv_api_keys_key_hash_key UNIQUE (key_hash)
  ck  zv_api_keys_permissions_mode_check CHECK ((permissions_mode = ANY (ARRAY['scoped'::text, 'casbin'::text, 'god'::text])))
  pk  zv_api_keys_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  rls enabled forced
  pol zv_api_keys_tenant_delete FOR d USING (zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id) OR ( SELECT zveltio_engine_outside_tenant('zv_api_keys'::regclass) AS zveltio_engine_outside_tenant)) CHECK -
  pol zv_api_keys_tenant_insert FOR a USING - CHECK (zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id) OR ( SELECT zveltio_engine_outside_tenant('zv_api_keys'::regclass) AS zveltio_engine_outside_tenant))
  pol zv_api_keys_tenant_select FOR r USING ((tenant_id = ANY (( SELECT zveltio_visible_tenants() AS zveltio_visible_tenants)::uuid[])) OR ( SELECT zveltio_engine_outside_tenant('zv_api_keys'::regclass) AS zveltio_engine_outside_tenant) OR (('apikey:'::text || (id)::text) = ( SELECT current_setting('zveltio.user_id'::text, true) AS current_setting))) CHECK -
  pol zv_api_keys_tenant_update FOR w USING (zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id) OR ( SELECT zveltio_engine_outside_tenant('zv_api_keys'::regclass) AS zveltio_engine_outside_tenant)) CHECK (zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id) OR ( SELECT zveltio_engine_outside_tenant('zv_api_keys'::regclass) AS zveltio_engine_outside_tenant))

table zv_edge_functions
  col code                           text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::text
  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col created_by                     text
  col description                    text
  col display_name                   text NOT NULL
  col egress                         ARRAY
  col env_vars                       jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
  col http_method                    text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'POST'::text
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col is_active                      boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
  col name                           text NOT NULL
  col path                           text NOT NULL
  col runtime                        text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'bun'::text
  col tenant_id                      uuid DEFAULT COALESCE((NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid)
  col timeout_ms                     integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 30000
  col updated_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  ck  zv_edge_functions_egress_check CHECK (((egress IS NULL) OR (cardinality(egress) = 0) OR ((array_ndims(egress) = 1) AND (array_lower(egress, 1) = 1) AND (cardinality(string_to_array(array_to_string(egress, ','::text, ''::text), ','::text)) = cardinality(egress)) AND (array_to_string(egress, ','::text, ''::text) ~ '^(\[[0-9a-f:.]+\]|[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?(\.[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?)*)(:[0-9]{1,5})?(,(\[[0-9a-f:.]+\]|[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?(\.[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?)*)(:[0-9]{1,5})?)*$'::text))))
  pk  zv_edge_functions_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  uq  zv_edge_functions_tenant_name_key UNIQUE (tenant_id, name)
  rls enabled forced
  pol tenant_isolation_zv_edge_functions FOR * USING (tenant_id = ANY (( SELECT zveltio_visible_tenants() AS zveltio_visible_tenants)::uuid[])) CHECK zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id)

  col status                         text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'::text
  col success_rows                   integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  col tenant_id                      uuid DEFAULT COALESCE((NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid)
  col total_rows                     integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  fk  zv_import_logs_created_by_fkey FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  ck  zv_import_logs_file_format_check CHECK ((file_format = ANY (ARRAY['csv'::text, 'xlsx'::text, 'json'::text, 'ndjson'::text])))
  ck  zv_import_logs_format_check CHECK ((format = ANY (ARRAY['csv'::text, 'json'::text, 'ndjson'::text]))) NOT VALID
  pk  zv_import_logs_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  ck  zv_import_logs_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'processing'::text, 'completed'::text, 'failed'::text, 'partial'::text])))
  rls enabled forced
  pol tenant_isolation_zv_import_logs FOR * USING (tenant_id = ANY (( SELECT zveltio_visible_tenants() AS zveltio_visible_tenants)::uuid[])) CHECK zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id)

  col started_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp()
  pk  zv_instances_pkey PRIMARY KEY (instance_id)

table zv_invitations
  col accepted_at                    timestamp with time zone
  col accepted_by                    text
  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col email                          text NOT NULL
  col expires_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col invited_by                     text
  col name                           text
  col role                           text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'member'::text
  col tenant_id                      uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT (NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid
  col token                          text NOT NULL
  fk  zv_invitations_accepted_by_fkey FOREIGN KEY (accepted_by) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  fk  zv_invitations_invited_by_fkey FOREIGN KEY (invited_by) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  pk  zv_invitations_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  fk  zv_invitations_tenant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id) REFERENCES zv_tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  uq  zv_invitations_token_key UNIQUE (token)
  rls enabled forced
  pol zv_invitations_tenant_delete FOR d USING (zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id) OR ( SELECT zveltio_engine_outside_tenant('zv_invitations'::regclass) AS zveltio_engine_outside_tenant)) CHECK -
  pol zv_invitations_tenant_insert FOR a USING - CHECK (zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id) OR ( SELECT zveltio_engine_outside_tenant('zv_invitations'::regclass) AS zveltio_engine_outside_tenant))
  pol zv_invitations_tenant_select FOR r USING ((tenant_id = ANY (( SELECT zveltio_visible_tenants() AS zveltio_visible_tenants)::uuid[])) OR ( SELECT zveltio_engine_outside_tenant('zv_invitations'::regclass) AS zveltio_engine_outside_tenant)) CHECK -
  pol zv_invitations_tenant_update FOR w USING (zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id) OR ( SELECT zveltio_engine_outside_tenant('zv_invitations'::regclass) AS zveltio_engine_outside_tenant)) CHECK (zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id) OR ( SELECT zveltio_engine_outside_tenant('zv_invitations'::regclass) AS zveltio_engine_outside_tenant))

table zv_media_files
  col alt_text                       text
  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col created_by                     text
  col created_by_api_key             uuid
  col deleted_at                     timestamp with time zone
  col deleted_by                     text
  col description                    text
  col duration_seconds               integer
  col filename                       text NOT NULL
  col folder_id                      uuid
  col height                         integer
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col metadata                       jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
  col mimetype                       text NOT NULL
  col original_name                  text NOT NULL
  col restore_folder_id              text
  col size                           bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  col storage_path                   text NOT NULL
  col tenant_id                      uuid DEFAULT COALESCE((NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid)
  col thumbnail_url                  text
  col title                          text
  col updated_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col url                            text
  col visibility                     text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'personal'::text
  col width                          integer
  fk  zv_media_files_created_by_api_key_fkey FOREIGN KEY (created_by_api_key) REFERENCES zv_api_keys(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  fk  zv_media_files_created_by_fkey FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  fk  zv_media_files_deleted_by_fkey FOREIGN KEY (deleted_by) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  fk  zv_media_files_folder_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (folder_id) REFERENCES zv_media_folders(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  pk  zv_media_files_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  ck  zv_media_files_visibility_check CHECK ((visibility = ANY (ARRAY['tenant'::text, 'personal'::text])))
  rls enabled forced
  pol media_files_user_delete RESTRICTIVE FOR d USING (( SELECT zveltio_media_sees_all() AS zveltio_media_sees_all) OR (created_by = ( SELECT zveltio_media_owner() AS zveltio_media_owner)) OR (created_by_api_key = ( SELECT zveltio_media_owner_key() AS zveltio_media_owner_key))) CHECK -
  pol media_files_user_insert RESTRICTIVE FOR a USING - CHECK (( SELECT (COALESCE(current_setting('zveltio.actor'::text, true), ''::text) <> 'on'::text)) OR (created_by = ( SELECT zveltio_media_owner() AS zveltio_media_owner)) OR (created_by_api_key = ( SELECT zveltio_media_owner_key() AS zveltio_media_owner_key)))
  pol media_files_user_select RESTRICTIVE FOR r USING (( SELECT zveltio_media_sees_all() AS zveltio_media_sees_all) OR (visibility = 'tenant'::text) OR (created_by = ( SELECT zveltio_media_owner() AS zveltio_media_owner)) OR (created_by_api_key = ( SELECT zveltio_media_owner_key() AS zveltio_media_owner_key))) CHECK -
  pol media_files_user_update RESTRICTIVE FOR w USING (( SELECT zveltio_media_sees_all() AS zveltio_media_sees_all) OR (visibility = 'tenant'::text) OR (created_by = ( SELECT zveltio_media_owner() AS zveltio_media_owner)) OR (created_by_api_key = ( SELECT zveltio_media_owner_key() AS zveltio_media_owner_key))) CHECK (( SELECT zveltio_media_sees_all() AS zveltio_media_sees_all) OR (visibility = 'tenant'::text) OR (created_by = ( SELECT zveltio_media_owner() AS zveltio_media_owner)) OR (created_by_api_key = ( SELECT zveltio_media_owner_key() AS zveltio_media_owner_key)))
  pol tenant_isolation_zv_media_files FOR * USING (tenant_id = ANY (( SELECT zveltio_visible_tenants() AS zveltio_visible_tenants)::uuid[])) CHECK zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id)

  rls enabled forced
  pol zv_media_shares_tenant_delete FOR d USING (zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id) OR ( SELECT zveltio_engine_outside_tenant('zv_media_shares'::regclass) AS zveltio_engine_outside_tenant)) CHECK -
  pol zv_media_shares_tenant_insert FOR a USING - CHECK (zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id) OR ( SELECT zveltio_engine_outside_tenant('zv_media_shares'::regclass) AS zveltio_engine_outside_tenant))
  pol zv_media_shares_tenant_select FOR r USING ((tenant_id = ANY (( SELECT zveltio_visible_tenants() AS zveltio_visible_tenants)::uuid[])) OR ( SELECT zveltio_engine_outside_tenant('zv_media_shares'::regclass) AS zveltio_engine_outside_tenant)) CHECK -
  pol zv_media_shares_tenant_update FOR w USING (zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id) OR ( SELECT zveltio_engine_outside_tenant('zv_media_shares'::regclass) AS zveltio_engine_outside_tenant)) CHECK (zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id) OR ( SELECT zveltio_engine_outside_tenant('zv_media_shares'::regclass) AS zveltio_engine_outside_tenant))

  col collection                     text NOT NULL
  col deleted_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col row_id                         uuid NOT NULL
  col tenant_id                      uuid NOT NULL
  rls enabled forced
  pol tenant_isolation_zv_sync_tombstones FOR * USING (tenant_id = ANY (( SELECT zveltio_visible_tenants() AS zveltio_visible_tenants)::uuid[])) CHECK zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id)

table zv_tenant_transfers
  col from_tenant                    uuid NOT NULL
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col moved_at                       timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col moved_by                       text
  col reason                         text
  col record_id                      uuid NOT NULL
  col table_name                     text NOT NULL
  col to_tenant                      uuid NOT NULL
  fk  zv_tenant_transfers_from_tenant_fkey FOREIGN KEY (from_tenant) REFERENCES zv_tenants(id)
  pk  zv_tenant_transfers_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  fk  zv_tenant_transfers_to_tenant_fkey FOREIGN KEY (to_tenant) REFERENCES zv_tenants(id)

table zv_tenant_users
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col invited_by                     text
  col joined_at                      timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col read_scope                     text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'self'::text
  col role                           text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'member'::text
  col scope_list                     ARRAY
  col tenant_id                      uuid NOT NULL
  col user_id                        text NOT NULL
  col valid_from                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col valid_to                       timestamp with time zone
  fk  zv_tenant_users_invited_by_fkey FOREIGN KEY (invited_by) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  pk  zv_tenant_users_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  ck  zv_tenant_users_read_scope_check CHECK ((read_scope = ANY (ARRAY['self'::text, 'subtree'::text, 'list'::text, 'org'::text])))
  ck  zv_tenant_users_role_check CHECK ((role = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::text, 'admin'::text, 'member'::text, 'viewer'::text])))
  ck  zv_tenant_users_scope_list_check CHECK ((((read_scope = 'list'::text) AND (scope_list IS NOT NULL) AND (cardinality(scope_list) > 0)) OR ((read_scope <> 'list'::text) AND (scope_list IS NULL))))
  fk  zv_tenant_users_tenant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id) REFERENCES zv_tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  uq  zv_tenant_users_tenant_id_user_id_key UNIQUE (tenant_id, user_id)
  fk  zv_tenant_users_user_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  rls enabled forced
  pol zv_tenant_users_tenant_delete FOR d USING (zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id) OR ( SELECT zveltio_engine_outside_tenant('zv_tenant_users'::regclass) AS zveltio_engine_outside_tenant)) CHECK -
  pol zv_tenant_users_tenant_insert FOR a USING - CHECK (zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id) OR ( SELECT zveltio_engine_outside_tenant('zv_tenant_users'::regclass) AS zveltio_engine_outside_tenant))
  pol zv_tenant_users_tenant_select FOR r USING ((tenant_id = ANY (( SELECT zveltio_visible_tenants() AS zveltio_visible_tenants)::uuid[])) OR ( SELECT zveltio_engine_outside_tenant('zv_tenant_users'::regclass) AS zveltio_engine_outside_tenant)) CHECK -
  pol zv_tenant_users_tenant_update FOR w USING (zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id) OR ( SELECT zveltio_engine_outside_tenant('zv_tenant_users'::regclass) AS zveltio_engine_outside_tenant)) CHECK (zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id) OR ( SELECT zveltio_engine_outside_tenant('zv_tenant_users'::regclass) AS zveltio_engine_outside_tenant))

table zv_tenants
  col closed_at                      timestamp with time zone
  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col merged_into                    uuid
  col name                           text NOT NULL
  col parent_id                      uuid
  col settings                       jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
  col slug                           text NOT NULL
  col status                         text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'::text
  col updated_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  fk  zv_tenants_merged_into_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merged_into) REFERENCES zv_tenants(id)
  fk  zv_tenants_parent_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES zv_tenants(id)
  pk  zv_tenants_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  uq  zv_tenants_slug_key UNIQUE (slug)
  ck  zv_tenants_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'suspended'::text, 'deleted'::text])))

table zv_validation_rules
  col collection                     text NOT NULL
  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col created_by                     text
  col error_message                  text NOT NULL
  col field_name                     text NOT NULL
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col is_active                      boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
  col nl_description                 text
  col rule_config                    jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
  col rule_type                      text NOT NULL
  col tenant_id                      uuid
  col updated_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  fk  zv_validation_rules_created_by_fkey FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  pk  zv_validation_rules_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  fk  zv_validation_rules_tenant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id) REFERENCES zv_tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE NOT VALID
  idx zv_validation_rules_instance_key UNIQUE (collection, field_name, rule_type, jsonb_hash_extended(rule_config, (0)::bigint)) WHERE (tenant_id IS NULL)
  rls enabled
  pol validation_rules_instance_or_tenant FOR r USING ((tenant_id IS NULL) OR zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id)) CHECK -

table zvd_accounts
  col code                           text NOT NULL

  col updated_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

  pol tenant_own_node_delete RESTRICTIVE FOR d USING (zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id) OR ( SELECT (NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text) IS NULL))) CHECK -
  pol tenant_own_node_update RESTRICTIVE FOR w USING (zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id) OR ( SELECT (NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text) IS NULL))) CHECK -
  pol zv_coll_create RESTRICTIVE FOR a USING - CHECK ( SELECT zveltio_collection_allows('accounts'::text, 'create'::text) AS zveltio_collection_allows)
  pol zv_coll_delete RESTRICTIVE FOR d USING ( SELECT zveltio_collection_allows('accounts'::text, 'delete'::text) AS zveltio_collection_allows) CHECK -
  pol zv_coll_read RESTRICTIVE FOR r USING ( SELECT zveltio_collection_allows('accounts'::text, 'read'::text) AS zveltio_collection_allows) CHECK -
  pol zv_coll_update RESTRICTIVE FOR w USING ( SELECT zveltio_collection_allows('accounts'::text, 'update'::text) AS zveltio_collection_allows) CHECK ( SELECT zveltio_collection_allows('accounts'::text, 'update'::text) AS zveltio_collection_allows)

table zvd_assets
  col accumulated_dep_account_id     uuid

  col asset_account_id               uuid
  col category                       text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'equipment'::text

  col supplier                       text

table zvd_billing_settings
  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col created_by                     text
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col scope                          text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'tenant'::text
  col search_vector                  tsvector
  col stripe_webhook_secret          text
  col tenant_id                      uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT COALESCE((NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid)
  col updated_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col updated_by                     text
  fk  zvd_billing_settings_created_by_fkey FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  pk  zvd_billing_settings_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  ck  zvd_billing_settings_stripe_webhook_secret_check CHECK (((stripe_webhook_secret IS NULL) OR (stripe_webhook_secret ~~ 'enc:v1:%'::text)))
  uq  zvd_billing_settings_tenant_id_scope_key UNIQUE (tenant_id, scope)
  fk  zvd_billing_settings_updated_by_fkey FOREIGN KEY (updated_by) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  rls enabled forced
  pol tenant_isolation FOR * USING (tenant_id = ANY (( SELECT zveltio_visible_tenants() AS zveltio_visible_tenants)::uuid[])) CHECK zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id)
  pol tenant_own_node_delete RESTRICTIVE FOR d USING (zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id) OR ( SELECT (NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text) IS NULL))) CHECK -
  pol tenant_own_node_update RESTRICTIVE FOR w USING (zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id) OR ( SELECT (NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text) IS NULL))) CHECK -
  pol zv_coll_create RESTRICTIVE FOR a USING - CHECK ( SELECT zveltio_collection_allows('billing_settings'::text, 'create'::text) AS zveltio_collection_allows)
  pol zv_coll_delete RESTRICTIVE FOR d USING ( SELECT zveltio_collection_allows('billing_settings'::text, 'delete'::text) AS zveltio_collection_allows) CHECK -
  pol zv_coll_read RESTRICTIVE FOR r USING ( SELECT zveltio_collection_allows('billing_settings'::text, 'read'::text) AS zveltio_collection_allows) CHECK -
  pol zv_coll_update RESTRICTIVE FOR w USING ( SELECT zveltio_collection_allows('billing_settings'::text, 'update'::text) AS zveltio_collection_allows) CHECK ( SELECT zveltio_collection_allows('billing_settings'::text, 'update'::text) AS zveltio_collection_allows)

  col account_id                     uuid NOT NULL

  rls enabled forced

  pol tenant_own_node_delete RESTRICTIVE FOR d USING (zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id) OR ( SELECT (NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text) IS NULL))) CHECK -
  pol tenant_own_node_update RESTRICTIVE FOR w USING (zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id) OR ( SELECT (NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text) IS NULL))) CHECK -

table zvd_dashboard_shares
  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col created_by                     text NOT NULL
  col dashboard_id                   uuid NOT NULL
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col permission                     text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'view'::text
  col shared_with_role               text
  col shared_with_user_id            text
  fk  zvd_dashboard_shares_dashboard_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (dashboard_id) REFERENCES zv_dashboards(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  uq  zvd_dashboard_shares_dashboard_id_shared_with_role_key UNIQUE (dashboard_id, shared_with_role)
  uq  zvd_dashboard_shares_dashboard_id_shared_with_user_id_key UNIQUE (dashboard_id, shared_with_user_id)
  ck  zvd_dashboard_shares_permission_check CHECK ((permission = ANY (ARRAY['view'::text, 'edit'::text])))
  pk  zvd_dashboard_shares_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)

table zvd_dashboard_subscriptions
  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col dashboard_id                   uuid NOT NULL
  col day_of_week                    integer
  col email                          text NOT NULL
  col frequency                      text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'weekly'::text
  col hour_of_day                    integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 8
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col is_active                      boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
  col last_sent_at                   timestamp with time zone
  col user_id                        text NOT NULL
  fk  zvd_dashboard_subscriptions_dashboard_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (dashboard_id) REFERENCES zv_dashboards(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  uq  zvd_dashboard_subscriptions_dashboard_id_user_id_key UNIQUE (dashboard_id, user_id)
  ck  zvd_dashboard_subscriptions_frequency_check CHECK ((frequency = ANY (ARRAY['daily'::text, 'weekly'::text, 'monthly'::text])))
  pk  zvd_dashboard_subscriptions_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)

  pol zv_coll_update RESTRICTIVE FOR w USING ( SELECT zveltio_collection_allows('efactura_messages'::text, 'update'::text) AS zveltio_collection_allows) CHECK ( SELECT zveltio_collection_allows('efactura_messages'::text, 'update'::text) AS zveltio_collection_allows)

table zvd_efactura_settings
  col access_token                   text
  col callback_url                   text
  col client_id                      text
  col client_secret                  text
  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col created_by                     text
  col environment                    text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'test'::text
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col last_error                     text
  col last_verified_at               timestamp with time zone
  col oauth_state                    text
  col oauth_state_expires_at         timestamp with time zone
  col refresh_token                  text
  col scope                          text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'tenant'::text
  col search_text                    text
  col search_vector                  tsvector
  col seller_cif                     text
  col tenant_id                      uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT COALESCE((NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid)
  col token_expires_at               timestamp with time zone
  col updated_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col updated_by                     text
  ck  zvd_efactura_settings_access_token_check CHECK (((access_token IS NULL) OR (access_token ~~ 'enc:v1:%'::text)))
  ck  zvd_efactura_settings_client_secret_check CHECK (((client_secret IS NULL) OR (client_secret ~~ 'enc:v1:%'::text)))
  fk  zvd_efactura_settings_created_by_fkey FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  ck  zvd_efactura_settings_oauth_state_check CHECK (((oauth_state IS NULL) OR (oauth_state ~~ 'enc:v1:%'::text)))
  pk  zvd_efactura_settings_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  ck  zvd_efactura_settings_refresh_token_check CHECK (((refresh_token IS NULL) OR (refresh_token ~~ 'enc:v1:%'::text)))
  uq  zvd_efactura_settings_tenant_id_scope_key UNIQUE (tenant_id, scope)
  fk  zvd_efactura_settings_updated_by_fkey FOREIGN KEY (updated_by) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  rls enabled forced
  pol tenant_isolation FOR * USING (tenant_id = ANY (( SELECT zveltio_visible_tenants() AS zveltio_visible_tenants)::uuid[])) CHECK zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id)
  pol tenant_own_node_delete RESTRICTIVE FOR d USING (zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id) OR ( SELECT (NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text) IS NULL))) CHECK -
  pol tenant_own_node_update RESTRICTIVE FOR w USING (zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id) OR ( SELECT (NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text) IS NULL))) CHECK -
  pol zv_coll_create RESTRICTIVE FOR a USING - CHECK ( SELECT zveltio_collection_allows('efactura_settings'::text, 'create'::text) AS zveltio_collection_allows)
  pol zv_coll_delete RESTRICTIVE FOR d USING ( SELECT zveltio_collection_allows('efactura_settings'::text, 'delete'::text) AS zveltio_collection_allows) CHECK -
  pol zv_coll_read RESTRICTIVE FOR r USING ( SELECT zveltio_collection_allows('efactura_settings'::text, 'read'::text) AS zveltio_collection_allows) CHECK -
  pol zv_coll_update RESTRICTIVE FOR w USING ( SELECT zveltio_collection_allows('efactura_settings'::text, 'update'::text) AS zveltio_collection_allows) CHECK ( SELECT zveltio_collection_allows('efactura_settings'::text, 'update'::text) AS zveltio_collection_allows)

table zvd_exchange_rates
  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col created_by                     text
  col date                           date NOT NULL
  col from_currency                  text NOT NULL
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col rate                           numeric NOT NULL
  col search_text                    text
  col search_vector                  tsvector
  col source                         text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual'::text
  col tenant_id                      uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT COALESCE((NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid)
  col to_currency                    text NOT NULL
  col updated_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col updated_by                     text
  fk  zvd_exchange_rates_created_by_fkey FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  pk  zvd_exchange_rates_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  uq  zvd_exchange_rates_tenant_id_from_currency_to_currency_date_key UNIQUE (tenant_id, from_currency, to_currency, date)
  fk  zvd_exchange_rates_updated_by_fkey FOREIGN KEY (updated_by) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

  uq  zvd_invoices_tenant_id_number_key UNIQUE (tenant_id, number)

  col search_text                    text
  col search_vector                  tsvector
  col tenant_id                      uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT COALESCE((NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid)
  col updated_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col updated_by                     text
  fk  zvd_journal_lines_account_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES zvd_accounts(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT
  fk  zvd_journal_lines_cost_center_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (cost_center_id) REFERENCES zvd_cost_centers(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT
  fk  zvd_journal_lines_created_by_fkey FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  fk  zvd_journal_lines_entry_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (entry_id) REFERENCES zvd_journal_entries(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE
  pk  zvd_journal_lines_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  fk  zvd_journal_lines_updated_by_fkey FOREIGN KEY (updated_by) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  rls enabled forced
  pol tenant_isolation FOR * USING (tenant_id = ANY (( SELECT zveltio_visible_tenants() AS zveltio_visible_tenants)::uuid[])) CHECK zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id)
  pol tenant_own_node_delete RESTRICTIVE FOR d USING (zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id) OR ( SELECT (NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text) IS NULL))) CHECK -
  pol tenant_own_node_update RESTRICTIVE FOR w USING (zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id) OR ( SELECT (NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text) IS NULL))) CHECK -
  pol zv_coll_create RESTRICTIVE FOR a USING - CHECK ( SELECT zveltio_collection_allows('journal_lines'::text, 'create'::text) AS zveltio_collection_allows)
  pol zv_coll_delete RESTRICTIVE FOR d USING ( SELECT zveltio_collection_allows('journal_lines'::text, 'delete'::text) AS zveltio_collection_allows) CHECK -

table zvd_migrator_connections
  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col created_by                     text
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col name                           text NOT NULL
  col objects                        jsonb
  col objects_at                     timestamp with time zone
  col objects_error                  text
  col search_text                    text
  col search_vector                  tsvector
  col source                         text NOT NULL
  col tenant_id                      uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT COALESCE((NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid)
  col token                          text NOT NULL
  col updated_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col updated_by                     text
  fk  zvd_migrator_connections_created_by_fkey FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  pk  zvd_migrator_connections_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  ck  zvd_migrator_connections_token_check CHECK (((token IS NULL) OR (token ~~ 'enc:v1:%'::text)))
  fk  zvd_migrator_connections_updated_by_fkey FOREIGN KEY (updated_by) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  rls enabled forced
  pol tenant_isolation FOR * USING (tenant_id = ANY (( SELECT zveltio_visible_tenants() AS zveltio_visible_tenants)::uuid[])) CHECK zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id)
  pol tenant_own_node_delete RESTRICTIVE FOR d USING (zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id) OR ( SELECT (NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text) IS NULL))) CHECK -
  pol tenant_own_node_update RESTRICTIVE FOR w USING (zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id) OR ( SELECT (NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text) IS NULL))) CHECK -
  pol zv_coll_create RESTRICTIVE FOR a USING - CHECK ( SELECT zveltio_collection_allows('migrator_connections'::text, 'create'::text) AS zveltio_collection_allows)
  pol zv_coll_delete RESTRICTIVE FOR d USING ( SELECT zveltio_collection_allows('migrator_connections'::text, 'delete'::text) AS zveltio_collection_allows) CHECK -
  pol zv_coll_read RESTRICTIVE FOR r USING ( SELECT zveltio_collection_allows('migrator_connections'::text, 'read'::text) AS zveltio_collection_allows) CHECK -
  pol zv_coll_update RESTRICTIVE FOR w USING ( SELECT zveltio_collection_allows('migrator_connections'::text, 'update'::text) AS zveltio_collection_allows) CHECK ( SELECT zveltio_collection_allows('migrator_connections'::text, 'update'::text) AS zveltio_collection_allows)

  col columns                        jsonb

  rls enabled forced

  pol tenant_own_node_delete RESTRICTIVE FOR d USING (zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id) OR ( SELECT (NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text) IS NULL))) CHECK -
  pol tenant_own_node_update RESTRICTIVE FOR w USING (zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id) OR ( SELECT (NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text) IS NULL))) CHECK -

  pol zv_coll_delete RESTRICTIVE FOR d USING ( SELECT zveltio_collection_allows('migrator_fetches'::text, 'delete'::text) AS zveltio_collection_allows) CHECK -
  pol zv_coll_read RESTRICTIVE FOR r USING ( SELECT zveltio_collection_allows('migrator_fetches'::text, 'read'::text) AS zveltio_collection_allows) CHECK -
  pol zv_coll_update RESTRICTIVE FOR w USING ( SELECT zveltio_collection_allows('migrator_fetches'::text, 'update'::text) AS zveltio_collection_allows) CHECK ( SELECT zveltio_collection_allows('migrator_fetches'::text, 'update'::text) AS zveltio_collection_allows)

  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

  col currency                       text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'RON'::text
  col description                    text
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()

  col unit                           text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'piece'::text
  col updated_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col updated_by                     text
  fk  zvd_products_created_by_fkey FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

  uq  zvd_products_tenant_id_sku_key UNIQUE (tenant_id, sku)
  fk  zvd_products_updated_by_fkey FOREIGN KEY (updated_by) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  rls enabled forced
  pol tenant_isolation FOR * USING (tenant_id = ANY (( SELECT zveltio_visible_tenants() AS zveltio_visible_tenants)::uuid[])) CHECK zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id)
  pol tenant_own_node_delete RESTRICTIVE FOR d USING (zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id) OR ( SELECT (NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text) IS NULL))) CHECK -
  pol tenant_own_node_update RESTRICTIVE FOR w USING (zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id) OR ( SELECT (NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text) IS NULL))) CHECK -

table zvd_push_tokens
  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col device_name                    text
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col platform                       text NOT NULL
  col token                          text NOT NULL
  col updated_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col user_id                        text NOT NULL
  pk  zvd_push_tokens_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  ck  zvd_push_tokens_platform_check CHECK ((platform = ANY (ARRAY['fcm'::text, 'apns'::text, 'web'::text])))
  uq  zvd_push_tokens_token_key UNIQUE (token)

table zvd_relations
  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col foreign_key_constraint         text
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col junction_table                 text
  col metadata                       jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
  col name                           text NOT NULL
  col on_delete                      text DEFAULT 'SET NULL'::text
  col on_update                      text DEFAULT 'CASCADE'::text
  col source_collection              text NOT NULL
  col source_field                   text NOT NULL
  col target_collection              text NOT NULL
  col target_field                   text
  col type                           text NOT NULL
  col updated_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  ck  zvd_relations_on_delete_check CHECK ((on_delete = ANY (ARRAY['CASCADE'::text, 'SET NULL'::text, 'RESTRICT'::text, 'NO ACTION'::text])))
  ck  zvd_relations_on_update_check CHECK ((on_update = ANY (ARRAY['CASCADE'::text, 'SET NULL'::text, 'RESTRICT'::text, 'NO ACTION'::text])))
  pk  zvd_relations_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  uq  zvd_relations_source_collection_source_field_key UNIQUE (source_collection, source_field)
  ck  zvd_relations_type_check CHECK ((type = ANY (ARRAY['m2o'::text, 'o2m'::text, 'm2m'::text, 'm2a'::text])))

table zvd_rls_policies
  col collection                     text NOT NULL
  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col description                    text
  col filter_field                   text NOT NULL
  col filter_op                      text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'eq'::text
  col filter_value_source            text NOT NULL
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col is_enabled                     boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
  col role                           text NOT NULL
  col updated_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  pk  zvd_rls_policies_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)

  col updated_by                     text

table zvd_stock_levels
  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()

  col quantity                       numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  col reserved_qty                   numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  col search_vector                  tsvector
  col tenant_id                      uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT COALESCE((NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid)
  col updated_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col updated_by                     text
  col warehouse_id                   uuid NOT NULL
  fk  zvd_stock_levels_created_by_fkey FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  pk  zvd_stock_levels_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  fk  zvd_stock_levels_product_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES zvd_products(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT
  uq  zvd_stock_levels_tenant_id_product_id_warehouse_id_key UNIQUE (tenant_id, product_id, warehouse_id)
  fk  zvd_stock_levels_updated_by_fkey FOREIGN KEY (updated_by) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  fk  zvd_stock_levels_warehouse_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (warehouse_id) REFERENCES zvd_warehouses(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT
  rls enabled forced

table zvd_tickets
  col assignee_id                    text
  col category_id                    uuid
  col channel                        text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'web'::text
  col closed_at                      timestamp with time zone
  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col created_by                     text
  col description                    text NOT NULL
  col first_response_at              timestamp with time zone
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col is_merged                      boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
  col merged_into_id                 uuid
  col metadata                       jsonb
  col number                         text NOT NULL
  col priority                       text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium'::text
  col requester_email                text NOT NULL
  col requester_name                 text
  col resolved_at                    timestamp with time zone
  col search_text                    text
  col search_vector                  tsvector

  col sla_due_at                     timestamp with time zone

  col tenant_id                      uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT COALESCE((NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid)
  col title                          text NOT NULL
  col updated_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col updated_by                     text
  fk  zvd_tickets_category_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES zvd_ticket_categories(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE SET NULL
  fk  zvd_tickets_created_by_fkey FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  fk  zvd_tickets_merged_into_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merged_into_id) REFERENCES zvd_tickets(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT
  pk  zvd_tickets_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  uq  zvd_tickets_tenant_id_number_key UNIQUE (tenant_id, number)
  fk  zvd_tickets_updated_by_fkey FOREIGN KEY (updated_by) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  rls enabled forced

  pol tenant_own_node_update RESTRICTIVE FOR w USING (zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id) OR ( SELECT (NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text) IS NULL))) CHECK -

  pol zv_coll_delete RESTRICTIVE FOR d USING ( SELECT zveltio_collection_allows('tickets'::text, 'delete'::text) AS zveltio_collection_allows) CHECK -

  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col created_by                     text NOT NULL
  col errors                         jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb
  col failed_count                   integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col imported_count                 integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  col tenant_id                      uuid DEFAULT COALESCE((NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid)
  pk  zvd_validation_import_log_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  rls enabled forced
  pol tenant_isolation_zvd_validation_import_log FOR * USING zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id) CHECK zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id)

table zvd_validation_rule_groups
  col collection                     text NOT NULL
  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col created_by                     text NOT NULL
  col description                    text
  col field_name                     text NOT NULL
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col is_active                      boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
  col logic                          text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'AND'::text
  col name                           text NOT NULL
  col rule_ids                       ARRAY NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::uuid[]
  ck  zvd_validation_rule_groups_logic_check CHECK ((logic = ANY (ARRAY['AND'::text, 'OR'::text])))
  pk  zvd_validation_rule_groups_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  idx zvd_validation_rule_groups_collection_name UNIQUE (collection, name)

table zvd_validation_test_cases
  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col created_by                     text NOT NULL
  col expected_result                boolean NOT NULL
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col input_value                    text NOT NULL
  col label                          text NOT NULL
  col last_run_at                    timestamp with time zone
  col last_run_result                boolean
  col previous_value                 text
  col rule_id                        uuid NOT NULL
  col tenant_id                      uuid DEFAULT COALESCE((NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid)
  pk  zvd_validation_test_cases_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  rls enabled forced
  pol tenant_isolation_zvd_validation_test_cases FOR * USING zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id) CHECK zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id)

table zvd_warehouses
  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col created_by                     text
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col is_active                      boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
  col location                       text
  col name                           text NOT NULL
  col notes                          text
  col search_text                    text
  col search_vector                  tsvector
  col tenant_id                      uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT COALESCE((NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid)
  col updated_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col updated_by                     text
  fk  zvd_warehouses_created_by_fkey FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  pk  zvd_warehouses_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  fk  zvd_warehouses_updated_by_fkey FOREIGN KEY (updated_by) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  rls enabled forced
  pol tenant_isolation FOR * USING (tenant_id = ANY (( SELECT zveltio_visible_tenants() AS zveltio_visible_tenants)::uuid[])) CHECK zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id)
  pol tenant_own_node_delete RESTRICTIVE FOR d USING (zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id) OR ( SELECT (NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text) IS NULL))) CHECK -
  pol tenant_own_node_update RESTRICTIVE FOR w USING (zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id) OR ( SELECT (NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text) IS NULL))) CHECK -
  pol zv_coll_create RESTRICTIVE FOR a USING - CHECK ( SELECT zveltio_collection_allows('warehouses'::text, 'create'::text) AS zveltio_collection_allows)
  pol zv_coll_delete RESTRICTIVE FOR d USING ( SELECT zveltio_collection_allows('warehouses'::text, 'delete'::text) AS zveltio_collection_allows) CHECK -
  pol zv_coll_read RESTRICTIVE FOR r USING ( SELECT zveltio_collection_allows('warehouses'::text, 'read'::text) AS zveltio_collection_allows) CHECK -
  pol zv_coll_update RESTRICTIVE FOR w USING ( SELECT zveltio_collection_allows('warehouses'::text, 'update'::text) AS zveltio_collection_allows) CHECK ( SELECT zveltio_collection_allows('warehouses'::text, 'update'::text) AS zveltio_collection_allows)

table zvd_webhook_deliveries
  col attempt                        integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col delivered_at                   timestamp with time zone
  col error                          text
  col event_id                       uuid
  col headers                        jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col max_attempts                   integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 3
  col method                         text NOT NULL
  col payload                        jsonb NOT NULL
  col response_body                  text
  col status                         integer
  col tenant_id                      uuid DEFAULT COALESCE((NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid)
  col url                            text NOT NULL
  col webhook_id                     uuid NOT NULL
  pk  zvd_webhook_deliveries_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  fk  zvd_webhook_deliveries_webhook_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (webhook_id) REFERENCES zvd_webhooks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  idx zvd_webhook_deliveries_event UNIQUE (webhook_id, event_id)
  rls enabled forced
  pol tenant_isolation_zvd_webhook_deliveries FOR * USING (tenant_id = ANY (( SELECT zveltio_visible_tenants() AS zveltio_visible_tenants)::uuid[])) CHECK zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id)

table zvd_webhooks
  col active                         boolean DEFAULT true
  col collections                    ARRAY
  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col created_by                     text
  col events                         ARRAY NOT NULL
  col headers                        jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col method                         text DEFAULT 'POST'::text
  col name                           text NOT NULL
  col retry_attempts                 integer DEFAULT 3
  col run_as_role                    text DEFAULT 'tenant_member'::text
  col secret                         text
  col tenant_id                      uuid DEFAULT COALESCE((NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid)
  col timeout                        integer DEFAULT 5000
  col updated_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col url                            text NOT NULL
  fk  zvd_webhooks_created_by_fkey FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  ck  zvd_webhooks_method_check CHECK ((method = ANY (ARRAY['POST'::text, 'PUT'::text, 'PATCH'::text])))
  pk  zvd_webhooks_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  ck  zvd_webhooks_retry_attempts_check CHECK (((retry_attempts >= 0) AND (retry_attempts <= 10)))
  ck  zvd_webhooks_timeout_check CHECK (((timeout >= 1000) AND (timeout <= 30000)))
  rls enabled forced
  pol tenant_isolation_zvd_webhooks FOR * USING (tenant_id = ANY (( SELECT zveltio_visible_tenants() AS zveltio_visible_tenants)::uuid[])) CHECK zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id)
